text: Twelve computers each cabled to a central hub. What is the topology?
choices: Physically a star, logically a bus
explanation: The cabling radiates from one point, so physically it is a star. A hub is an electrical repeater that copies every signal to every port, so every station hears every transmission — logically identical to a shared coaxial bus, with collisions and CSMA/CD. Replacing the hub with a switch changes nothing physical and everything logical.
